rationale: Orca resolves to Orca Acquisitions, LLC, a manager-level ArcLight Fund VI and Olympus joint-venture platform. It is not merely an individual generating project or a duplicate of Walleye Power. Orca indirectly owns Walleye through Walleye Energy Holdings, and Walleye owns and operates Bay Shore. The authoritative methodology includes manager-level platforms and excludes subsidiaries or projects only when they sit beneath an already-counted platform. Create Orca once and keep Walleye, its intermediate holding company, Bay Shore and the generating units below the canonical boundary.

identityResolution.platformBoundary: Orca Acquisitions, LLC is the canonical manager-level joint-venture platform.
identityResolution.subsidiaryBoundary: Walleye Energy Holdings, LLC and Walleye Power, LLC are downstream holding and operating companies and are not separate PortCos.
identityResolution.assetBoundary: Bay Shore and its individual generating units are assets beneath Walleye and are not separate PortCos.
identityResolution.duplicateDecision: No existing canonical company or seed record matches Orca.

structuredManagerOwner.fund: ArcLight Energy Partners Fund VI, L.P.
structuredManagerOwner.stake: 95% of Class A managing interests; exact overall economic interest not publicly disclosed
structuredManagerOwner.control: ArcLight appoints two management-committee members and controls day-to-day decisions.

otherLegalEquityParticipation.stake: Remaining 5% of Class A managing interests plus all non-managing, non-voting Class B interests; exact overall economic interest not publicly disclosed
otherLegalEquityParticipation.repoTreatment: Preserve in the description and evidence. Do not characterize Olympus as only a 5% economic owner.

operatingResolution.subsector: Merchant power generation and industrial steam
operatingResolution.operatingAsset: Bay Shore Generating Facility, Oregon, Ohio
operatingResolution.currentScale: FERC reports a 136 MW summer-rated steam unit and a 16 MW oil-fired unit in its June 2026 filing.
operatingResolution.services: Merchant electricity generation in PJM and industrial steam supply.
operatingResolution.ratingDifference: Olympus presents 154 MW and 17 MW figures without the same summer-rating basis. Use the newer FERC summer-rated figures and label their basis.

acquisitionExitCheck.ownershipStructureDate: The disclosed amended and restated Orca LLC agreement is dated 2016-07-25.
acquisitionExitCheck.bayShoreSigning: Walleye signed the Bay Shore asset-purchase agreement on 2018-03-09.
acquisitionExitCheck.walleyeRename: Walleye Energy changed its name to Walleye Power effective 2018-05-23.
acquisitionExitCheck.bayShoreClosing: The Bay Shore acquisition closed on 2018-07-31.
acquisitionExitCheck.currentOwnership: A 2026 FERC filing continues to show Orca above Walleye and ArcLight Fund VI above ArcLight Orca Holdings. ArcLight's live investment page continues to list Orca as Current.
acquisitionExitCheck.subsequentExitSearch: No Orca-, Walleye- or Bay Shore-specific equity sale, signed exit, dissolution, rename of the parent platform or pending change of control was identified through 2026-08-14.

Orca's original state-law formation date and headquarters are not established by the opened sources.
